name: cAMP synthesis, phosphodiesterase breakdown and PKA activation
rationale: All members concern the cAMP second-messenger cycle (GPCR/forskolin-driven synthesis, PDE1 catabolism, PKA activation and its restraint), and unlike the adenylate cyclase-centred confusables the theme includes cAMP degradation and PKA activation.

name: LXR-regulated triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis
rationale: Members regulate triglyceride and fatty acid balance, including NR1H2/NR1H3 (LXR) control of lipogenesis and adipose lipolysis genes, whereas confusables centre on lipid droplet dynamics, lipophagy and triglyceride catabolism.

core: Two-pore-domain potassium channels and resting membrane potential
name: Two-pore-domain K+ channels and inhibition of cation flux
rationale: Members are K2P leak channels (TREK, TASK, TWIK, THIK, TRESK) setting resting potential plus negative regulation of sodium, potassium and calcium transport, which the confusables (Ca2+-activated, KATP, TALK/TRP channels) lack.

name: snRNA transcription and spliceosomal pre-mRNA splicing
rationale: Members cover spliceosome assembly, splice-site recognition and major/minor splicing together with Pol II/Pol III snRNA transcription, distinguishing it from Pol III transcription confusables (no splicing) and the RNA decay/processing confusable (no snRNA transcription).

qualifier: microtubule nucleation, centriole control and cytokinesis
name: Mitotic centrosome, spindle microtubule and cytokinesis organization
rationale: Members span centrosome/centriole duplication and cohesion, microtubule nucleation and dynamics, spindle assembly and orientation, cilium disassembly and contractile-ring cytokinesis, while confusables centre on chromosome condensation and sister chromatid cohesion.

qualifier: downstream MAPK, PLC-gamma, STAT3 and CREB transcription
name: NGF–TRKA signalling to MAPK, CREB and transcription
rationale: All members are TRKA activation and its downstream adaptor, kinase and transcriptional branches, distinguishing the theme from p75NTR death signalling and NTRK3 confusables.

qualifier: oncogenic RAF mutants and ERK negative feedback
name: Oncogenic RAF–MAPK signalling and ERK feedback inactivation
rationale: Members cover BRAF/RAF1 mutant and fusion signalling, MEK/ERK/RSK activation, and ERK dephosphorylation and negative feedback, which the MRAS/SHOC2 and RAS-GAP confusables lack.

qualifier: biosynthesis control and lipoprotein receptor uptake
name: Cholesterol homeostasis via biosynthesis control and lipoprotein receptor uptake
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol synthesis via SREBP sensing and limit LDLR/VLDLR-mediated uptake (including LXR action), combining what confusables split into efflux/SREBF activation versus endocytic LDL clearance.

name: Regulation of NOD1/NOD2 signalling in peptidoglycan sensing
rationale: Members are NOD1/NOD2 and NLR signalling and responses to peptidoglycan and muramyl dipeptide in antibacterial immunity, versus inflammasome, C-type lectin antifungal and TAK1/TLR confusables.

qualifier: amyloid precursor protein synthesis and catabolism
name: Amyloid fibril formation and amyloid precursor protein regulation
rationale: Members regulate amyloid fibril formation and APP biosynthesis/catabolism (with APP-linked amide metabolism terms), whereas confusables focus on amyloid-beta clearance and glial activation.

name: Dietary carbohydrate digestion and intestinal hexose and glycoside transport
rationale: Members cover disaccharide digestion and its deficiencies, intestinal hexose (fructose, galactose) uptake and glycoside/flavone handling, while confusables emphasise SLC transporter diseases and urate or amino acid transport.

qualifier: cell size regulation in cardiac and skeletal muscle
name: Cardiac and skeletal muscle growth and cell size regulation
rationale: Members regulate sarcomere organization, cardiac adaptation, skeletal muscle growth and cell size in response to activity, unlike confusables centred on atrophy/inactivity or calcineurin-NFAT signalling.

qualifier: collagen, fibronectin and elastic fibres with integrin binding
name: Collagen, fibronectin and elastic fibre extracellular matrix assembly
rationale: Members cover collagen trimerization and crosslinking, fibronectin and elastic fibre assembly, integrin and DDR collagen signalling and stromal ECM gene modules, while confusables emphasise laminin, hemidesmosome and collagen biosynthesis.

name: Hedgehog ligand autoprocessing, lipidation and release
rationale: Members concern Hh autoproteolytic processing, HHAT palmitoylation, release from secreting cells and ERAD of processing mutants, distinguishing it from Notch glycosylation, Wnt secretion and RAS lipidation confusables.

qualifier: parturition, uterine contraction and sexual function
name: Reproductive and social behaviour, parturition and uterine contraction
rationale: Members combine mating, parental, aggressive and drinking behaviour with erection, insemination, relaxin receptors, parturition and uterine contraction, the reproductive physiology that stress-, exploration- and sleep-related confusables lack.

name: Dentin and cementum formation in tooth development
rationale: Members concern odontoblast differentiation, dentinogenesis, cementum mineralization, tooth eruption and secreted-protein phosphorylation, unlike confusables about enamel/bone mineralization or ectodermal appendage placodes.

qualifier: T cell immunological synapse and polarity
name: Leukocyte integrin adhesion, migration and T cell immunological synapse
rationale: Members cover integrin/PECAM1-mediated leukocyte adhesion and migration plus T cell synapse formation, polarity, raft localization and second messengers, combining what confusables split into integrin activation or CD28-Vav signalling.

qualifier: transcriptional and post-translational control of CDH1, CDH11 and CDH19
name: Transcriptional and post-translational control of cadherins in EMT
rationale: Members regulate CDH1, CDH11 and CDH19 transcription, processing and degradation within EMT, whereas confusables cover adherens junction assembly and junctional adhesion without cadherin gene regulation.

name: Protein stability control involving RHOBTB atypical Rho GTPases
rationale: Members regulate protein stabilization, destabilization and proteasomal degradation together with RHOBTB1-3 cycles, which distinguish it from confusables on deubiquitination, chaperonin folding or neddylation.

name: Glycogen and glucose-6-phosphate metabolism and storage diseases
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis, breakdown, glycophagy and glycogen storage diseases with glucose-6-phosphate/glucokinase and gluconeogenic steps, whereas confusables centre on glycolysis and fructose metabolism.

name: IL-6 signalling with ERK1/2 activation and inactivation
rationale: Members are IL-6/JAK-STAT3 signalling and its restraint plus ERK1/2 activation, dephosphorylation and negative feedback, distinguishing it from IL-27/35 confusables and from MAPK-only regulation confusables.

name: Branched-chain ketoacid dehydrogenase complex and maple syrup urine disease
rationale: All members concern BCKDH catalysis, its regulatory kinase/phosphatase and their deficiencies causing MSUD, whereas confusables cover downstream leucine/valine catabolism and biotin-dependent carboxylase disorders.

qualifier: hydroxylation, oxidation and methylation including collagen crosslinking
name: Residue hydroxylation, oxidation and methylation including collagen crosslinking
rationale: Members are lysine/proline hydroxylation, protein oxidation (collagen crosslinking, arylsulfatase activation) and methylation, with collagen and basement membrane maturation absent from the translation-factor modification confusables.

name: Amyloid-beta formation, clearance and cellular response
rationale: Members regulate amyloid-beta formation, fibrillization, clearance and cellular responses plus APP synthesis and tangle assembly, whereas confusables add glial activation or focus on fibril formation without clearance.

qualifier: restraint of epithelial–mesenchymal transition and substrate attachment
name: Adherens junction assembly opposing epithelial–mesenchymal transition
rationale: Members cover calcium-dependent cadherin adhesion, adherens junction assembly and apical constriction with negative regulation of EMT and substrate attachment, which confusables centred on junction maintenance and apical-basal polarity lack.
